items.item_text: Assesses educational needs through various formal and informal methods, in close consultation with the Perioperative Management teams and staff, ensuring alignment with departmental priorities and challenges.

Conducts evaluations of all projects and initiatives for desired outcomes, sharing findings and proposing revisions to the Perioperative facility leadership teams. Revises future work goals, methods and processes to support evidence-based practice and quality care in collaboration with market leaders. Ensures educational activities are congruent with nursing strategies, goals, values and vision and are tailored to meet the specific needs and operational mandates of the perioperative departments and facility leadership.
Annually conducts educational needs assessment using a variety of methods, presenting findings and proposed educational plans to the Perioperative leadership team for feedback and approval.

Evaluates educational projects based on system needs and agreed upon outcome criteria. Regularly communicates progress and outcomes to the Perioperative leadership team and reports broader outcomes to the Market Chief Nurses.
Collaborate with the market leaders of Perioperative Services to ensure 100% implementation of all perioperative safety initiatives, and other identified patient safety projects.
Report timely status on perioperative safety initiatives to the Chief nurses, Directors of Emergency Services, Patient Safety, and Clinical Risk Management leadership.
Review data and processes to evaluate compliance with perioperative safety initiatives, regulatory requirements, and hospital policies.
Support the market in the roll-out of perioperative safety projects and goals, reporting results and providing necessary training.
Develop, implement, and facilitate learning opportunities and drills for the perioperative departments, including topics such as Mock Codes, disaster preparedness, and critical incident simulations.
Current and Active CA Registered Nurse
